phases.title: Enrich schema show members with per-kind details and 20-member truncation

review_findings.message: custom_data member payload emits `key` plus the full parsed `value` where spec 0005 Architecture item 1 enumerates `id`, `schema`, and `value_preview` for that kind; the custom_data table has no `schema` column (src/schema.rs:57-61), so the spec list is unsatisfiable as written and the substitution (brief's key/value shape, full value rather than a bounded preview) is unrecorded anywhere.

phases.title: Enrich brief schema:<id> member payload with the same per-kind details

review_findings.message: AC-2's 'the response includes the schema summary and kind' is met only via the envelope's kind:"schema" node marker plus payload summary: node_payload does not select the schema's v14 classification kind that spec 0004 surfaced on list/show/prime/confirm (show selects it at list.rs:190), so if AC-2's kind means that classification, brief is the one read path not carrying it and no test disambiguates the reading.

resolve_schema's doc comment promises an exact name is never shadowed by a slug collision and the scan comment promises first-fold-match-wins on colliding folds, but no test seeds a slug collision or an exact-name-vs-slug-shadow case (the slug test seeds a single schema), so a reorder of the id/name/slug arms or a slug_fold change would pass silently.

resolve_schema is shared with schema show (list.rs:186) and schema refine (list.rs:234), so the new slug fallback quietly widens both commands' target acceptance beyond the spec API line 'schema ID or exact name'; the phase records no spec_deviations entry for the extension.

The slug scan collects the full Vec<(i64, String)> only to iterate it once with early return; rule 005 (no throwaway intermediate collections) favors driving the loop directly off query_map, which also short-circuits without materializing the tail.

phases.title: Add refine trigger and rule flags with summary trigger validation

review_findings.message: The no-flags arm of refine_text ('nothing to refine: pass --summary, or --trigger with --rule') is the only new error branch without a unit or CLI test, so the implementer's documented no-flag-bail judgment call could be dropped or reworded silently while every sibling arm (synthesis, prefix acceptance, rejection guidance, half-pair, mixed flags) stays pinned.

starts_with byte-prefix matching admits openings outside spec 0005:97's four enumerated phrases — 'Whenever builds fail: ...' and 'Whence ...' pass validation because they byte-start with 'When' (proven live against a temp DB) — so the accepted vocabulary is a superset of the canonical list.

The synthesized path assumes --trigger/--rule are non-empty: '--trigger "" --rule "run tests"' stores the degenerate agent-authored summary 'Fires when : run tests' (proven live), while the codebase's own boundary convention rejects empty user text (custom.rs:81 'search query cannot be empty', decision.rs:290).

phases.title: Surface matching schemas in advise output above constraints

review_findings.message: advise --staged with an empty staging area returns {"schemas": [], ...} (the early-return line this phase changed to add the schemas key), but no test exercises the staged path; the three-key shape and schemas-first key order on that branch are unpinned, while git-fixture precedent exists (tests/cli.rs:3091) so the branch is directly testable

recorded Gate 3 commands never execute tests/memory.rs (verified: cargo test --test cli advise matches only the 2 new tests, 70 filtered; --bin engrams schemas is bin-only), so the s14 trigger-compliant summary repair this phase carries runs in no recorded gate; Gate 5's full cargo test is the only backstop. Fourth occurrence of the green-without-exercising genre (0002 phase 2; 0004 phases 1/3/4)

docs/memory/engrams.md:194 documents the advise return contract as {"constraints": [...], "violations": [...]}; the schemas key this phase adds leaves the canonical command reference stale, and phase 6 (docs) covers only the new cognitive-schemas page so no phase owns this line

phases.title: Rank context-matching schemas in prime block by paths and tags

review_findings.message: path_match_counts' third resolution arm (target path nested under an anchor directory, '? LIKE a.path || '/%') is unpinned: the unit test covers exact match and anchor-under-target only, so an operand-order regression in that arm passes silently; the reference query_relevant_ids has no arm-level tests either, so no existing pin backstops the new SQL
